definitions.gloss: to pulsate; to throb; to beat
definitions.explanation: To beat or throb rhythmically, as a pulse or heartbeat. Refers to the rhythmic movement of blood through arteries.

definitions.gloss: to pulse with life; to be alive with energy
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to be vibrant and full of life or energy. Used for cities, cultures, or anything that feels dynamically alive.

notes:
USAGE:
{脈打|みゃくう}つ is a godan verb combining ⟦{脈|みゃく}→脈：05247_myaku⟧ (pulse) and ⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (to strike). It is intransitive.

ASPECT (ている):
{脈打|みゃくう}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes an ongoing, rhythmic pulsation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{脈打|みゃくう}つ (the heart beats)
- ⟦こめかみ→こめかみ：05293_komekami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{脈打|みゃくう}つ (temples throb)
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{脈打|みゃくう}つ (life pulses)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{鼓動|こどう}→鼓動：19609_kodou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means to beat (of the heart) and focuses specifically on the heartbeat. {脈打|みゃくう}つ is broader and can describe any pulsating movement, including figurative uses.
